latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Year-End Personal Annual Report skill.

- Helps users create a structured, reflective annual report in the style of a company report.
- Covers wins, lessons, finances, relationships, health, work, values, risks, and next-year priorities.
- Includes interview prompts, outline, summary, full report draft, and an operating plan for the coming year.
- Provides audience and tone customization, with options to protect private details.
- Sets clear safety and privacy boundaries; not intended for professional advice or diagnosis.
